main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 bars, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and timing gain > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: timing gain (book mean daily return minus market-rise gain)

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the timing gain is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: The slope is an ordinary least-squares fit with intercept of every forecast > 0 bar's next-day excess return (coin mean over all its within-window daily returns) on its forecast, its t being slope over the fit's standard error, and the plan's 'fewer than 300 is inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow's minimum-count rule.
